navigate_browser_page: navigate to a URL in the browser and return a compact page snapshot with interactive elements
get_page_snapshot: get a text-based snapshot of the current page's accessibility tree using ref IDs for element interaction
interact_with_elements: click on an element identified by its ref ID or type text into an input field
analyze_page_with_vision: take a screenshot of the current page and analyze it with vision AI for visual content understanding
cleanup_browser_sessions: clean up all active browser sessions and reap orphaned daemon processes from previous runs
